meaning:
δοκιμή, -ῆς, ἡ
(δόκιμος), [in Sm.: Psa.68:31 * ;]
1. the process of trial, proving, test: 2Co.8:2 9:13
2. The result of trial, approval, approvedness, proof: Rom.5:4, 2Co.2:9 13:3, Php.2:22 (Cremer, 212, 701).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope:
For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.
But you know the proof of him, that as a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.
